adapter.name: aspace-openai-plugins-adapter
surface: python3 aspace-openai-plugins-adapter/mock_plugin.py manifest -> print a minimal valid plugin manifest (JSON, stdout)
python3 aspace-openai-plugins-adapter/mock_plugin.py validate [path/to/plugin-dir] -> structure check of .codex-plugin/plugin.json (exit 0/2, stdlib only)
python3 aspace-openai-plugins-adapter/mock_plugin.py env -> telemetry-off environment (no network, no credentials)

upstream.license: none (no LICENSE file, GitHub license: null)

clean_room.rule: no upstream file copied; the adapter is written from the public plugin-manifest format only
clean_room.proof: blob-hash comparison against the gel tree (see ADAPTATION.md § Preuve zéro copie)
clean_room.fallback: deletion of the fork (repli suppression nommé, D12)

telemetry.verdict: zero by construction — the adapter makes no network call (stdlib only, no socket/urllib), holds no credential, and never starts a plugin MCP server
